description: This Java class 'OutputContentFile' extends 'StaticContentFile' and implements Serializable. It serves as a data carrier for static content data, particularly transferring content from cache to the service layer. It encapsulates a ByteArrayOutputStream representing the file content.

classes.name: OutputContentFile
classes.description: Represents static content data transfer object with file content stored in a ByteArrayOutputStream, used within the service layer.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Returns the ByteArrayOutputStream containing the file content.

methods.name: setFile
methods.description: Sets the ByteArrayOutputStream containing the file content.
